statement: The coordinator handles staging, initial issue structure, dispatch and supervision; Summit performs deep source/repository review, granular decomposition and justified design. The PM stack effort is explicitly separate. The earlier implementing-agent prompt is future acceptance context, not authority to implement during design.
source_precedence_resolution: Current user directions and intake note govern. This coordinator document defines the design-run split and does not authorize full implementation.
user_outcome: Keep this task focused on design/research and separate the CA workstream from PM delivery.
verified_current_behavior: No launch or implementation state is proven by this source.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Source inventory, architecture review and granular issue plan; use PM patterns only when genuinely shared.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: No live secrets or production operation implied.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Deliver the design artifacts and granular issue tree, not an implementation assertion.
migration_or_rollback: N/A; future implementation remains separately staged.

statement: The full source package includes governing spec, research, decision review, future implementing-agent prompt and historical input; archive hash and internal manifest are verification targets. Current user/addendum refine specific conflicts; full spec governs elsewhere; proposals and older alternatives require validation or supersession notes.
source_precedence_resolution: Follows note.md precedence: current instructions, addendum, full spec, proposal review, then historical inputs where not superseded.
user_outcome: Retain source provenance, inspect every authoritative item and resolve conflicts explicitly.
verified_current_behavior: Hash and package statements are source assertions until checked.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Record hash, per-file integrity results and precedence decisions.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Recompute archive hash and verify each manifest-listed file; trace conflicts to governing source.
migration_or_rollback: Record intentional source revisions rather than enforcing stale hashes blindly.

statement: Coordinator preflight requires repository/issue/work-in-flight inspection, relevant queue/outbox and dispatch contract verification, actual supported writer/route discovery, and an intake manifest; documentation alone does not prove deployment or tool behavior.
source_precedence_resolution: Operational preflight instructions, not product requirements.
user_outcome: Base design and issue decisions on verified repository and live-tool facts.
verified_current_behavior: Must be verified during run; source does not assert completion.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Census, pinned baseline, source manifest and verified writer/route contracts.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Use authorized access and do not infer live capabilities from docs.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Repository SHA and actual capability receipts recorded; issue/PR searches performed.

statement: Source staging requires authorized transfer, identity/path checks, immutable private staging, checksum verification, intake receipt and safe non-public handling; if staging is unavailable, report the blocker rather than claiming completion.
source_precedence_resolution: Execution instructions; current user rules and authorization govern.
user_outcome: Ensure Summit can read an intact source snapshot without publishing private material or risking the primary checkout.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Authorized laptop staging with hashes and INTAKE.md; alternate authorized route only if verified.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Authorized transfer identity and file paths only.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Verified size/hash/internal manifest and readable source snapshot.
migration_or_rollback: Do not reset primary checkout; record blocker if staging fails.

statement: A central parent issue should index the design, use established Project/epic conventions, avoid interchangeable duplicate parents and distinguish hierarchy from dependencies. Historical suggested urgency and Project taxonomy require validation against current conventions.
source_precedence_resolution: Use current issue/Project conventions and the canonical epic/domain starters in note.md; do not hard-code historical labels without validation.
user_outcome: Keep one discoverable canonical design parent with correct native issue relationships.
verified_current_behavior: Current Project mappings must be verified separately.
proposed_architecture_or_API: One parent, native domain starter hierarchy, separate dependency edges.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Readback confirms canonical parent, correct Kind and native hierarchy/dependencies.
migration_or_rollback: Reuse matching existing parent rather than duplicating.

statement: The suggested ten starter themes are historical high-level decompositions spanning census, architecture, secrets/custody, reconciliation, performance, generators, PKI, operations and future research; create/reuse a small set after deduplication and do not create hundreds of low-quality tickets. Current starters in note.md control this run.
source_precedence_resolution: Current note.md defines the actual starters; this earlier suggested list is context and does not override them.
user_outcome: Preserve broad domain coverage while deduplicating and keeping the issue tree actionable.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Use domain starters and children in note.md, not a second interchangeable parent set.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Each starter has bounded domain scope; no duplicates; coverage audit traces statements.
evidence_status: historical suggestion mapped to current starters

statement: Each granular issue must be independently actionable and identify one deliverable, kind, source IDs/ranges, outcome/acceptance, repo evidence, boundaries, API/CLI, native dependencies, safe environment, tests/negative tests, priority/status, size/stage, recovery and open decisions; split independent acceptance outcomes without atomizing trivial coding.
source_precedence_resolution: This applies to future granular proposals/issues; current inventory output is not itself an issue backlog.
user_outcome: A competent implementer can pick one child issue and complete it without reconstructing the entire source package.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Use the stated issue fields and split criteria when downstream mapper creates proposals.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Explicitly state authorized synthetic vs production boundary per issue.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Schema-level completeness check per issue; acceptance criterion is independently measurable and includes negative verification where relevant.
migration_or_rollback: Include rollback/recovery when deliverable mutates state.

statement: High-volume issue writes use the authorized GitHub App/outbox path with inspectable proposals, stable deduplication keys, existing-issue search, quotas/backoff, idempotent receipts/reconciliation, native relationships and post-write verification; do not bypass safety or assume pending intent means created issue.
source_precedence_resolution: Use current sanctioned writer verified at execution; no raw issue creation assumed.
user_outcome: Create issue proposals reliably without duplicates or false completion claims.
verified_current_behavior: Actual installed interface must be discovered and verified.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Plan, deduplicate, enqueue/write, store receipts, verify hierarchy and publish index.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Authorized GitHub App writer and quota only.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Every created issue read back with labels/relationships; pending outbox is not counted as creation.
migration_or_rollback: Retry only after idempotent status check; use bounded fallback if outbox insufficient.

statement: Direct dispatch binds the canonical issue to an authorized Summit route/task/session, verifies prompt delivery and activity, records all launch receipts, avoids ordinary-claim double launch, and does not treat Do Now or session creation alone as a started task.
source_precedence_resolution: Run-level contract; current route and authorization determine actual mechanism.
user_outcome: The design task starts exactly once with the intended prompt on the intended authorized route and remains verifiably bound.
verified_current_behavior: Requires real receipt and session activity evidence.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Inspect direct path, bind issue/task/session, verify route and prompt acknowledgement, store launch fields.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Explicit Summit route; no silent fallback; no claimant mode change or bypass of caps.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Read back task ID, session ID, route, issue binding, prompt acknowledgement, ownership and active status.
migration_or_rollback: Use authorized idempotent recovery; never double launch over live session.

statement: The embedded Summit prompt preserves full sources, repo census, exact PKI matrix, provider/authorization distinctions, research vs implementation boundary, safety gates, justified alternatives and final checkpoint/report; source links are to be delivered intact.
source_precedence_resolution: Prompt is a future handoff; current user message and staged sources are authoritative.
user_outcome: The launched agent receives complete scope and does not infer production authority or implementation completion.
verified_current_behavior: No prompt-delivery state proven by prompt text.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Use prompt as source guidance, reconciled against current instructions.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: bw and production root/sync scopes require separate authorization.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Prompt acknowledgement and content receipt are verified; final report links requirements and evidence.

statement: Consequential design choices need ADRs comparing options, evidence, security/performance/maintenance tradeoffs, recommendation, migration, rejection reasons and reversal tests; challenge listed unsupported assumptions. Production safety limits and secret non-disclosure remain explicit.
normative_history_admin_class: design quality and binding safety context
source_precedence_resolution: User safety boundaries and current authority govern; coordinator adds design-quality evidence obligations.
user_outcome: Produce decisions grounded in source evidence and do not perform or claim unauthorized production actions.
verified_current_behavior: No action is authorized by listing it in a design source.
proposed_architecture_or_API: ADRs and explicit synthetic-vs-production status; retain privacy of all secrets and private keys.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Live vault/root/DNS/trust/deployment operations require explicit applicable approval.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Each consequential ADR cites source evidence and a test/reversal trigger; scan deliverables for secret material.
migration_or_rollback: Reviewed rollback and custody controls before approved mutations.

statement: Issue priority/status/staging must distinguish urgency, importance, scheduling pressure and dispatch directive; future research is normally deferred, root operations approval-blocked, and completion needs verified evidence. Numeric priorities and Project labels follow current canonical contracts.
source_precedence_resolution: Current note and PM/queue charter control exact policy; this source warns against hard-coded historical values.
user_outcome: Represent issue state and safety blocks accurately without mistaking design enumeration for completion.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Use current lifecycle/status model; mark production root work blocked pending authority.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Approval-gated tasks cannot be presented as Ready.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Audit labels/status against current state and evidence receipts.
migration_or_rollback: No priority convention migration without checking current queue contract.

statement: Suggested output tree includes architecture, matrix, precedence, roadmap, provider/custody/PKI/benchmark/issue artifacts and ADRs; use local conventions, avoid empty scaffolding, preserve stable IDs if split, and link actual diagrams/experiments.
source_precedence_resolution: Suggested paths yield to repo documentation conventions; do not create empty placeholder deliverables.
user_outcome: Provide a useful, navigable design package with stable traceability.
verified_current_behavior: Suggested tree is not evidence of files created.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Inventory, human summary, source precedence, architecture, tests/evidence, issue index as appropriate.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: No secret material in public artifacts.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Each claimed deliverable contains substantive content and links to actual evidence.
migration_or_rollback: Split thematic matrices without changing IDs.

statement: Durable supervision, when required and available, must use a real registered monitor, check meaningful activity/session binding/blockers/coverage, answer only from evidence, recover idempotently, and end only on verified terminal state; do not promise unsupported background monitoring.
source_precedence_resolution: Use actual available supervisor; explicit report if none exists.
user_outcome: Maintain accurate task supervision without fictional check-ins or duplicate launches.
verified_current_behavior: Monitor must have an actual durable receipt; instruction alone proves nothing.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Existing monitor/watch mechanism with keyed cadence and checkpoints.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Authorized answer/recovery channel; respect approval gates.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Verify monitor ID, cadence, activity checkpoints and terminal-state audit.
migration_or_rollback: Stop monitor only after verified completion or authorized cancellation.

statement: Summit completion requires verified source/repo review, precedence, census, ADRs, matrix, linked issue tree and issue-write receipts, dependencies, safe research separation and final evidence report; design completion does not close implementation work.
source_precedence_resolution: Completion criteria apply to the planning mission; implementation issues stay in appropriate open states.
user_outcome: Close only the verified design task and leave future implementation work visible.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Final coverage/issue audit and evidence-backed report.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Every checklist item has a verifiable artifact/receipt or explicit limitation.
migration_or_rollback: Keep implementation epic open until implementation acceptance passes.

statement: Coordinator launch receipt and Summit final report require specific identifiers, evidence, source/repo hashes, route/session, issue counts, ADRs, blockers, research/approval status, tests, critical path, next stage and unresolved items.
source_precedence_resolution: Report fields are evidence checklists, not facts until populated and verified.
user_outcome: Give the parent a complete, auditable handoff rather than transcript-only claims.
verified_current_behavior: No receipt values asserted by source.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Structured launch/final report with explicitly unknown or blocked fields preserved.
provider_capabilities_and_permissions: Do not expose secrets in reports.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Report field audit: every required field has a verified value or explicit unavailable/blocker reason.

statement: Closing summary restates inspect/stage/create/dispatch/verify/supervise and Summit design tasks; never equate queue position with launch, post with acknowledgement, outbox with issue creation, design with implementation, or fixture success with production authorization. The linked companion PM charter remains separate.
source_precedence_resolution: Summary only; the full source and current user authority govern.
user_outcome: Report verified states and keep the companion workstream separate.
verified_current_behavior: Closing text is not proof that any step occurred.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Use distinct evidence/receipt for each state transition.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Each claimed transition is backed by its own current receipt.

statement: Document identity/version/date/priority/route metadata and assignment scope; historical lane and route data must not override current bound route instructions.
source_precedence_resolution: Current user explicitly selects opencode-route/workhorse; historical route text is provenance only.
user_outcome: Identify this document and the scope it was written for.
verified_current_behavior: Metadata is not a live dispatch receipt.
proposed_architecture_or_API: Use current session route and authorized scope, not historical values.
acceptance_test_or_benchmark: Verify current route from live mechanism.

statement: Heading and blank separator introducing the mandatory design area list; substantive design statements are itemized in COORD7-0001 through COORD7-0008.
source_precedence_resolution: Heading only; substantive body inventoried separately.
